ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Zikru uses the camera when you photograph a zikr (the text is recognised on your phone and the photo stays on the device) or when you yourself turn on video during a group call: the image is then sent to the participants through our call server, without recording.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Zikru opens the photo you choose to recognise its text on the device. Nothing is uploaded.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Zikru uses the microphone only if you turn it on during a group call: your voice is sent to the participants through our call server, without recording.
